```{=html}
<script>
// Shorten long author lists to the first MAX_AUTHORS names plus "et al.".
// Hidden names stay in the DOM so the Filter box still matches them.
// This runs before Quarto's listing script initializes.
(function () {
  const MAX_AUTHORS = 3;
  document.querySelectorAll(".listing-author").forEach(function (el) {
    const html = el.innerHTML.trim();
    const authors = html.split(/,\s*/);
    if (authors.length <= MAX_AUTHORS + 1) return;
    el.innerHTML =
      authors.slice(0, MAX_AUTHORS).join(", ") +
      ', <span aria-hidden="true">et al.</span>' +
      '<span class="visually-hidden">' + authors.slice(MAX_AUTHORS).join(", ") + "</span>";
    el.title = html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "");
  });
  // Card thumbnails repeat the title next to them, so mark them decorative.
  document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing img:not([alt])").forEach(function (img) {
    img.alt = "";
  });
})();
</script>
```
